CalculatedFields.Name: Overage %
CalculatedFields.Expression:
/*
Percentage of Agent Hours that are billable overage, indicating budget utilization and upsell opportunities.
*/
ifelse(sum({Agent Hours}) = 0, NULL, sum({Billable Overage Hours}) / sum({Agent Hours}) * 100)

CalculatedFields.Name: Utilization %
CalculatedFields.Expression:
/*
Percentage of included hours consumed, measuring how efficiently allocated hour budgets are being used.
*/
ifelse(sum({Included Hours}) = 0, NULL, sum({Agent Hours}) / sum({Included Hours}) * 100)

CalculatedFields.Name: Sync Success Flag
CalculatedFields.Expression:
/*
Binary indicator (1 for success, 0 otherwise) for filtering and aggregating successful sync runs.
*/
ifelse({Sync Result} = 'SUCCESS', 1, 0)
